changes: Split Universe.OnFrame() into two methods - one to complete and apply thread worker results, the other to launch the next frame's workers. This allows us to slot input handling in-between, so we can make object modifications in response to user input that can't conflict with currently-running thread workers.
As a result, the 'simulate' console command works again.
Added some column helper methods to ImGuiHelper.
Fixed up the formatting of checkboxes in the FlightPlan and Plan UIs into columns.
Added Set target checkbox to the transfer planner UI. Set target turns on aN and dN nodes, this is a console command, but now can be turned on and off via the transfer planner UI.
Moved ImGui rendering between thread worker executions as well since we also process input like button clicks during this time.
Moved auto burn execution into the new flight computer.
Added the rotation gizmo when editing thruster directions
Added ability to reference objects in a SystemTemplate from the AssetBundles. This allows a definition to be reused in System Templates, avoiding having to copy and paste a lot of definitions.
Split ShadowMapSize into Vessel and Terrain settings, to allow independent values. Will reset peoples settings. This improves the VRAM calculation, as vessel shadow map size was not being considered.
Added translate gizmo for thrust editing and a tiny box to help find the current location. Box Gizmo should also be reusable wherever you need a random floating box somewhere.

Fixed library changes broke the system that prunes data for smaller system. Now the modlibrary will exclude actually processing the load for bundle templates that it does not need, when it comes to astronomical objects.
Fixed the little box that would always appear in the top left of the screen.
Moved FPS and MS frame statistics to its own widget and added a setting for it.
Fixed some more scaling bugs in the editor
Extended Jamies Alert system to include simulation changes and follow camera changes, caching strings for commonly used changes.
Partial progress towards Vehicle Gauges rendering to secondary windows
Added alert notifications for camera changes, including some string caching.
Added an override for StringEnumCollection so that nicer Vulkan setting option can be displayed in combo.
Fix discontinuity in godrays close to terminator due to shadow bias
Set different bias values for terrain shadows and godrays
Split out measured properties (acceleration, delta V) from kinematic states. This lets us do things like sum up or average them, and we can now see the "current" acceleration for each Vehicle.
Added precise burn cutoff to the flight computer.
Changed alerts so that non-timed alerts are drawn first, and timed ones and optimized how they were handled to ensure fixed alerts can never be removed accidentally.
Escape now closes the settings menu when pressed again.
Added Vessel quick goto in Universe menu.
Added action key assignment for Frame Statistics (FPS).
Added Welcome and Config popup to interface settings menu in case they need to be set after execution, to save editing settings files.
Removed some unused legacy textures.
Changed comets to be static celestials so that they use the normal planetary spherical drawing.
Updated summary textures.
Fixed preview rendering of selected transfer maneuvers to be done in Render
Moved debug log info for closest approach solver behind compiler directive with the rest of the debug log info.
Fixed unset vehicle target not resetting target info on maneuver patches.
Fix the missing T bar on the Navball after adding multi-window support
Fixed the big flicker that would occur on certain terrain vertices
Fixed camera UBO not updating time value
Fixed a case of getting a NaN eccentricity because of a barely-out-of-range acos input.
Added SafeAcos and SafeAsin which clamp their inputs to prevent NaNs.
Used SetOrbit() in a couple places that we should have been.
Changed some of the default values for sunflare for a more artistic result.
Export per-engine thrust from the physics update and use that to drive exhaust plumes rather than using input keys.
Consolidated Vehicle manual control inputs into a single struct.
Fixed another place where inputs were being used to trigger visual exhausts.

Added first pass of Fragment Shader based buttons. Migrated the navball controller buttons to this system. Generic system driven from XML data to allow bindings to system components. Will rescale to any resolution with crisp SDF font as well. Second pass needs to allow better positioning and scaling of these widgets.
dither currently removed - due to other changes below
moved 'outer sun glow' to the pre pass bloom effect to offset overall solar scales
desirable if the overall scale is < 1.0 since the sun is only a handful of pixels in 1080p when viewed from the earth or further away - thus outer glow is the majority of the sun in most situations
outer bloom behaves 'with' inner bloom effects from before
dither not required as both inner and outer blooms will undergo a blur pass
modified bloom to be a more noticeable effect via an improved blur and scalar
bloom blur debug values 4 to 10 create an increased blur via offset (still at an efficiency phase but just for testing kernel radius ideas)
modified minimum transmittance to be calculated via the actual current cosZenith instead of a hard-locked value.
Added support for child component renderers
Removed accidental debug message when clicking a component.
proper cloud occlusion of sun and bloom via sampling cloud alpha when clouds are on
I fetch the rendertarget via an accessor through PlanetTransparencies into CloudRenderer
new debug option to toggle "cloud visbility" for the bloom passes
some adjustments to eclipsing flares based on cloud occlusion
[WIP] sampling of cloud texture alpha from high cloud scale
Fixed new ImGuiHelper.BeginColumns to handle supplied width percentages correctly.
Added public Clear() method to ManeuverPlan class.
Changed SafeOrbitRadius to public static method to allow reuse outside of OrbitalTransfers class.
Minor GLSL naming fix for non-windows platforms
Fixed Physics to detect when situation has changed from ground contact to outside safe orbital radius.
Changed OrbitalTransfer SafeOrbitRadius to use the one from CelestialBody so it aligns with Physics processsing.
Added Orbital Teleport tool to Debug menu.
Multi-buffering solution for the sun flares
Added a pass to better show what part/subpart is selected.
Stopped scroll wheel translating a part/subpart from getting behind the camera
Add some missing debug names for vulkan objects
Added some different height options for the orbit teleport debug tool.
Fixed gauge button instances were being passed through rasterizer with the full uv and then discarded if outside, preventing rasterizer from discarding pixels that are not needed.
Added debug bounds option for showing bounds for gauges and their widget instances.
Minor rework of debug menu as it was becoming cluttered.
Fixed unnecessary padding for GaugeInstance vertex data being sent to GPU.
Added planet terrain height pre-pass.

Added planet terrain realtime mesh normals generation. Now we can access the real mesh normals during rendering which is crucial for accurate biplanar calculations and terrain displacement directions. This could be extended to calculate mesh curvature and store it in the normal W component.
Added RenderableVertexBuffer and RenderableNormalsBuffer to the PlanetMeshCollection class. These buffers hold the data generated by the terrain mesh data pass in PlanetRenderer.cs.
Added mesh adjacency buffer to CubeMesh instances to support the new mesh data render pass.

Decoupled the planet mesh data from the main planet shaders. This allows us to regenerate the mesh data only when it changes LOD or snaps, rather than computing it each frame (currently still runs per-frame, taking around 0.3 to 0.5ms to compute for the mesh data pass)
Fixed mismatch tiling and blending calculations in Planet tesc and frag shaders.
Planet normals adjusted to fade from normal map to mesh normals based on distance to the terrain. The normal map will be a higher resolution than the mesh from afar, and vice versa for up close.
Updated planet and planet shadow vertex attribute bindings and vertex buffers from float3 to float4 to conform to the std430 layout for storage buffers.

Added a new parameter to SimpleVkMesh for all SetVertices functions which allows for additional buffer usages to be defined. For example, this allows a vertex buffer to be used both as a vertex buffer and a storage buffer if it will be populated by a compute shader.
Reduced the terrain tessellation displacement for all biomes on Luna as it was slightly too high, especially for cliffs.
Reduced the terrain texture displacement for Luna in the new Astronomicals XML
Swapped from textureNice to textureNiceAccurate in GenerateMeshHeight.comp
Removed unnecessary normalize function calls in Planet.frag
Fixed a short circuit I accidentally committed.
Fixed crash due to mismatch between descriptor pool size and allocations
Update KSA to Brutal v25.6.0.2
This change brings extra validation for mismatches between descriptor pools and the allocated sets for all platforms
fix for multisampling color attachment flags

Migrated the altitude gauge to be an instanced digit based gauge. This means the rasterizer is able to discard fragments earlier, dramatically reducing the per pixel cost. Also provides a template in XML to allow simpler gauge creation for other digits.
Add missing debug names for vulkan pipelines
Changed positioning and sizing of some of the UI windows for the vehicle so they don't start overlapping or too small.
Fixed incorrect rendering of existing vehicle patch when preview transfer is on in the transfer planner UI.
Fixed units displayed on input fields in teleport debug tool.
Added ignore safety margins checkbox to teleport debug tool.
Added a gizmo pass for all of the transform gizmos so they can rest on top of other world objects nicely
Added initial groundwork for the Canvas refactor for gauges.
Removed an unused descriptor set and related usage flags to fix some GPU specific validator warnings.
Added checkbox to toggle orbits for source and target celestials on and off in the Transfer Planner UI. Just a small QOL thing.
Ordering fix for offscreen texture resizing (viewports and gauges)
Fixed gauge font texture was bound to gauge renderer, making splitting off to canvases difficult. Now loaded once and binding passed to users.

Migrated Gauge UI to be defined centrally, this simplied the definitions significantly to allow for a canvas system to be layered on top. This removed the split between instance and template and centralized uv definitions with the shader pairs.
Added GaugeCanvas reference as an asset alongside GaugeComponent as an interim step towards migrating all GaugeComponent RenderTargets to use this to draw to.
Fixed default values for GaugeComponent were incorrect, as they would always anchor to 0,0.

Migrated all existing gauge components to be canvas based, allowing both inline component definitions as well as referenced ones. Same is allowed in vessel (and therefore later part) definitions as well.
Added all canvases will bind their components to them. This could cause issues in future, as currently a component can only be bound to a single canvas.

Major refactor of Gauge system. Now gauges are rendered onto canvases, and require them. Currently all gauges are unlocked and can be moved as a temporary measure. They do not reposition correctly when resolution is changed, currently.
Added mouse cursor will change when hovering over interactable button.
Added debug options to view bounds for gauge canvases, components, and instances.
Moved gauge shader definitions so they can be referenced easier.
Fixed can move a gauge window when clicking on a gauge interactable. Now this will be disabled when you are going to hover over an interactable element (such as a button).
Fixed gauges would be incorrectly positioned when changing screen size. Removed caching completely from both gauge canvas and components. This needs to be added back in later for optimization.

Fixed anchoring when dragging was completely broken. Created a new cache system that only records the delta change, this was necessary because the old system could not handle borderless or platform variation with absolute window positions. New the xml data is maintained, but change in position or size is remembered.
Replaced old PitchYawRoll single fragment shader with a new one that uses the Cavnas system, along with the required bindings.
Changed default pop-out behavior to require a toggle, as it made changing resolution very difficult.
Added edge case handling for adding a window back to the main viewport, but it is outside of the bounds. If this is detected, the position and scale will be reset.

Add more settings to better control exhausts appearance in the atmosphere: Control mach diamonds shape, offset direction and fades, control sharpness and opacity of of shock cells in exhausts, add gradient fades and sharpness to shock cells to give the appearance of diffusion of features along the length of the plume. Make wave structure in exhausts look more natural
Add more exhaust example configs emulating appearance of jet and rocket engines
Tweak Apollo CSM engine config and transition from atmosphere to vacuum
Fix visible artifacts in clouds and godrays when camera clips the terrain mesh (such as when launching from surface)
Add per-component phase functions to mie scattering

First pass on tweaking Mars atmosphere config, use per-component phase function for asymmetry to get a more realistic blue martian sunset that doesn't make the entire horizon blue. More tweaks are needed to the phase function for a more realistic result as the current one makes the atmosphere appear dimmer
Migrated the attitude rate indicators to be gauge components on top of the navball
Added tooltips option for gauge components. If a tooltip is defined, and the component is hovered, the tooltip will be shown.
Added support for sign in gauge digits.
Added Mars biome ID and control textures.
Added Mars terrain textures.

Added a mask to the diffuse alpha channel which determines how much of the diffuse colour will contribute towards the final terrain colour, versus diffuse multiplied by the planet's colour. This is useful if you want some colours to stand out but have the rest of the texture take the colour of the terrain.
Updated Mars diffuse and normal map. The dark areas are no longer blue!
